summary: A hand-authored novel-command hook attaches the pp:no-error-path-probe annotation to the generated get-group command at registration time, so it survives regeneration.
reason: Splitwise returns HTTP 200 with an empty/error envelope for unknown group IDs, so the generic error_path dogfood probe (which expects a non-zero exit for invalid args) false-fails on get-group. get-group is a generated file that must never be hand-edited, so the annotation cannot be set inline; instead the hand-authored splitwise_novel.go registers an init() hook that finds "get-group" on the root command tree and sets Annotations["pp:no-error-path-probe"]="true" after cobratree wiring. This re-homes the same fix from a direct edit (dropped by the 4.19.0 reprint) to a hook, so a 4.31.6+ regeneration keeps the annotation without touching the generated command file.
validated_outcome: Live dogfood (post re-attach): 165/165 passed, including get-group on an unknown id.
